0x1c.role: Byte offset into the sub-struct at pUnit->field11_0x2c; the data field read on the non-{2,4,5} dispatch path

0x2c.role: Byte offset of field11 (sub-struct pointer) within UnitAny — encoded in field name field11_0x2c; the pivot for both dispatch branches

0x64A.role: CleanupAndAbort error code — NULL pUnit or NULL pUnit->pStateLinkedList

0x40F.role: CleanupAndAbort error code — NULL active skill node pointer

0x641.role: Abort/diagnostic code passed to CleanupAndAbort when pUnit is NULL

0x3EA.role: Abort/diagnostic code passed to CleanupAndAbort when pUnit->pStateLinkedList is NULL

0x0.role: NULL pointer sentinel (return value when pUnit is NULL)

0xc.role: Sub-structure validity check offset (+0x30); compares pUnit[0xc] != 0 to verify sub-structure exists

0x40.role: Path field offset for Player/Monster units with valid sub-structure at +0x30

0x10.role: Default path field offset for other unit types (or Player/Monster without sub-structure)

-1.role: Process exit code passed to _exit() on NULL pUnit

0xffff.role: sentinel return value for no collision data

0.role: No target unit sentinel (validity guard indicating dwTargetUnit is not set)

0x5C.role: UnitAny structure offset to pStatList field

8.role: Bit shift amount to isolate bit 8 from flags field

0x100.role: Bit 8 mask value - identifies which bit is tested (bit position 8)

1.role: Single-bit isolation mask after right-shift operation

0x4.role: Bitmask for extracting flag bit 2 from stat list flags field at offset +0x34

0xff.role: Error sentinel return value when validation fails

0xFF.role: Error/sentinel return value on validation failure

0x45.role: Byte offset within ItemData struct to retrieve

0xffffff00.role: Pointer mask applied on failure return path

0x2000.role: Bit flag (bit 13) in dwFlagMask. When set, the function dispatches to the alternate linked list head (pAltListEntry at pStatList+0x40) instead of the primary head (pListEntry at pStatList+0x3C). The bit is then cleared from dwFlagMask before the per-entry flag match.

0xffffdfff.role: Bitwise NOT of 0x2000 (~0x2000). Used as a clear-bit mask: `dwFlagMask & 0xffffdfff` strips the alternate-list selector bit from dwFlagMask after dispatch so the remaining bits are used for flag matching against entry dwFlags.

0x49.role: Byte offset within pTypeData (ItemData) whose byte value is returned on success

0x14.role: Byte offset within UnitAny of the type-specific data pointer (pTypeData)

0xFFFFFF00.role: Mask applied to the return value on any validation-failure path, zeroing the upper 3 bytes (yields 0 because pItem is either the original NULL or was overwritten to NULL by the side-effect in the second condition)

0x1.role: 'items are in same code group' return value; boolean true once both items matched in a code group

0x80.role: Byte offset accessed within ItemDataTblRecord (decompiler alias pItemData->field_0x80); the uint at this offset is compared against each entry in the three code-group arrays. Note: decompiler alias only -- no real struct field at offset 0x80 in ItemDataTblRecord (size 303); likely a type-confusion with the following equip-type field

0xE4.role: ItemTypesTxt record stride (record size = 228 bytes) used in indexing: iVar2 * 0xE4

0x22.role: Byte offset within ItemTypesTxt record of the bFieldDD state-flag byte

-1 (0xFF).role: Sentinel value for the state-flag byte indicating invalid/unset; returned on miss or sentinel

100.role: default/fallback return value emitted when pItem is NULL, pItem->dwType != 4, the data record lookup returns NULL, or the record's nDexBonus equals the unset sentinel 1; returned via short (the type of nDexBonus) and treated by callers as 'no penalty / 100%'

0x00.role: fallback return value (uchar '\0') taken when pUnit is NULL or dwType != 4; note the doc comment claims 0x64 fallback but the proven decompiled code returns '\0' (0x00)

0xC0.role: Byte offset of dwFieldC0 within ITEMS_ItemRecord structure

0x23.role: Byte offset of the nVarInvGfx field within an ItemTypesTxt record (the byte returned)

0x46.role: Field offset on pPrevRoom containing the item data byte returned

0x1F.role: Bit-position mask: (nItemType & 0x1F) yields the 0..31 bit index of the target bit inside a 32-bit mask word

5.role: Right-shift amount: (nItemType >> 5) yields the dword index into pItemTypeBitmaskRows; pairs with 0x1F mask (2^5 - 1 = 0x1F)

0x30.role: sub-structure existence gate at pUnit+0x30; must be non-zero for Player/Monster path

0x80000000.role: Active-flag bit (high bit / sign bit) tested on StatList field at offset +0x10 (pModifierNode); <0 comparison = bit 31 set; when set, field at statlist+0x58 (pFlagMask) is returned
